title: Otter holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M 68 44 Q 72 35 70 28' fill='none' stroke='#f0e6a0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='20' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='16' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M 67 32 L 70 35 L 73 32 Z' fill='#dd2244'/>
  <!-- Otter body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='74' rx='11' ry='11' fill='#d4a876'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <!-- Face lighter area -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='56' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#d4a876'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='4' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='2' fill='#6b4528'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='4' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='2' fill='#6b4528'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='51' r='2.2' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='51' r='2.2' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='50.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffe8c0'/>
  <circle cx='53.8' cy='50.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffe8c0'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='56' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#3a2210'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M 45 59 Q 48 62 51 59' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a1a' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='38' y1='55' x2='31' y2='53' stroke='#c49060' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='57' x2='31' y2='58' stroke='#c49060' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='55' x2='65' y2='53' stroke='#c49060' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='57' x2='65' y2='58' stroke='#c49060' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <path d='M 32 68 Q 28 60 34 58' fill='none' stroke='#7a5030' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 64 66 Q 70 58 66 50' fill='none' stroke='#7a5030' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Paw holding string -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='3' fill='#6b4528'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#6b4528'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#6b4528'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M 30 80 Q 20 82 18 76' fill='none' stroke='#7a5030' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
